title: Too Many Tech Stocks Lurking in Your Portfolio? These 3 Investments Offer More Balance.
title_zh: 您的投资组合中潜藏着太多科技股？这三项投资提供更多平衡。
summary: Costco Wholesale, Procter & Gamble, and PepsiCo can help you immediately build a more risk-adjusted portfolio.
summary_zh: Costco Wholesale、Procter & Gamble 和 PepsiCo 可以帮助您立即建立风险调整程度更高的投资组合。

title: Microsoft Retirement Buyout Highlights Evolving Workforce And AI Investment Priorities
title_zh: 微软退休收购凸显不断变化的劳动力和人工智能投资优先事项
summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) has launched a large voluntary retirement buyout program for eligible U.S. employees. The offer includes extended cash payouts and healthcare benefits tied to specific age and years of service criteria.
summary_zh: 微软（NasdaqGS：MSFT）为符合条件的美国员工启动了一项大型自愿退休买断计划。该优惠包括与特定年龄和服务年限标准相关的延长现金支付和医疗保健福利。

title: JPMorgan Hikes IREN Price Target to $46 but Stays Underweight on Circular NVIDIA Deal Concerns
title_zh: 摩根大通将 IREN 目标价上调至 46 美元，但因对 NVIDIA 交易的担忧而保持减持
summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) raised its price target on Iren (NASDAQ:IREN) stock to $46 from $39 while keeping an Underweight rating.
summary_zh: 摩根大通（纽约证券交易所股票代码：JPM）将 Iren （纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）股票的目标价格从 39 美元上调至 46 美元，同时维持减持评级。

title: Apollo buying Emerald Holding and Questex in $1.5B deal
title_zh: Apollo 以 1.5B 美元的交易收购 Emerald Holding 和 Questex
summary: The private equity firm plans to combine the two B2B events companies into a single platform running about 160 events
summary_zh: 这家私募股权公司计划将两家 B2B 活动公司合并为一个运营约 160 项活动的单一平台

title: Apollo Strikes Deals for Two Live-Events Businesses
title_zh: 阿波罗为两家现场活动业务达成交易
summary: The investment firm is set to buy Emerald Holding and Questex with plans to combine them.
summary_zh: 该投资公司将收购 Emerald Holding 和 Questex，并计划将它们合并。
